_meta.what: Every Prosol branch as a possible customer pickup point for yourfloors.ca branch-pickup shipping rates (02 build plan 3B, tasks K5 and K8). Internal data: the distributor name must never reach customer-facing text; only rate_title is customer-facing.
sources: run-orders/scripts/shipstation/prosol-location-map.json (40 active branches, numeric keys; non-Prosol entries and the 3 old ShipStation duplicate ids skipped)

Prosol public location list (www.prosol.ca/contact CMS, 43 locations, fetched 2026-09-28; snapshot kept at cfc-projects/02-yf-schluter-trade/data/prosol-public-locations-2026-09-28.json). Addresses, phones, emails and hours come from this list.
cfc-projects/02-yf-schluter-trade/research/2026-09-28-prozone-build/prosol-network.md (F1 new branches, F2 map corrections, F7 Schluter coverage)
rules: enabled: Mac's go 2026-10-02 on the tier-1 set (PICKUP-ZONES-PLAN.md D1: Sechelt, Powell River + 17 hubs); Prosol supports customer pickup at every branch (Mac 2026-09-28). Flip a tier-2 branch on with Mac's go.
pilot marks the first branch to enable (Calgary South). pilot alone never publishes a rate.

code is the prosol-location-map.json code (the key for POs and per-branch stock) whenever the branch is in the map, so code equals map_code. Where the public list uses another code it is kept as display_code (Calgary South: code WCAS, public CALS). lib/branch-pickup.js and --preview resolve any of the three.

rate_title is customer-facing: 'Pickup at our <label> trade counter' (Coast: 'Pickup at our Sechelt warehouse' / 'Pickup at our Powell River showroom'). It starts with 'Pickup' (the run-orders local-fulfillment marker), never names the distributor, has no en/em dash, and must match exactly between the Prosol profile and the pickup-only profile (checkout keeps only rate names common to every profile in the cart).

map_corrections lists where prosol-location-map.json disagrees with the public list. ref "F2" = already found in prosol-network.md. The map itself is not changed here (build plan N5, a run-orders deploy).
Hours are Prosol's published walk-in hours, not a promise of pickup hours; check holidays (prosol-network.md F11).
_meta.rate_title_format: Pickup: <pickup_label> trade counter (ready in 2-4 business days)
_meta.coast: Rows with coast: true are CFC's own pickup points (Sechelt, Powell River), BC only, never a Prosol PO: they ride the Tue/Fri truck (PICKUP-FLOW.md).
